entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. The order number is VF98752.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you ordered the Aero-Dynamic Helmet about six weeks ago. How can I help you with it today?
Okay, I can look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color. It looked different online. It's hideous.
I see. I'm sorry to hear the color wasn't what you expected. Just to confirm, have you used the item at all?
No. The box is unopened. I knew as soon as I saw it.

Understood. Well, your safety is our top priority, and that includes being comfortable with your gear. Since it's a preference issue and the box is unopened, let me check the return eligibility. One moment...

Alright, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I see the helmet was delivered 46 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can definitely process this return for you.
Fine. So you're actually going to help?

Yes, of course. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.

And Sarah, I see here that you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've added a free expedited shipping credit to your account for your next order. Hopefully you can find a helmet with a color you prefer.
I've just sent it. It should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day, Sarah.
